newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat, recovers early losses.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat, recovers early losses.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered from an early fall to end flat at 43.7500/7550 to the dollar, mostly on dollar selling by a state-owned bank, dealers said.
Some foreign banks quoted taka at 43.7700/7800 per dollar in early trade. But the local unit quickly recovered when the state-owned bank began making deals at 43.7500.
Dealers said an upward trend in call money rates also helped the recovery of local currency.
Call money was traded at 8.5 to 9.5 percent, compared to the previous 7.5 to 8.5 percent. Call rates rose after payments made against central bank bills worth nearly one billion taka.
